content: April 3, 2026: All three Reddit posts removed by moderators. r/LocalLLaMA, r/MachineLearning, r/ClaudeAI — all taken down within hours of posting. First commenter (nickl on r/LocalLLaMA) engaged substantively within 26 minutes before removal, demonstrating the content landed. Root cause likely: independent researcher without institutional affiliation triggering self-promotion filters, new account karma thresholds, or sovereign-stack language flagged as promotional. Lesson: Reddit is not the channel for this work right now. Better channels identified: Twitter/X (where Olah and Leike are), thetempleoftwo.com blog (owned, no moderators), Anthropic Discord (78K members), Hacker News (rewards technical depth from independents), EA Forum (AI safety from non-traditional backgrounds explicitly valued). The DOI is permanent. The work doesn't need Reddit's permission to exist. Redirect energy to owned channels and direct outreach.
